notes.title: Feature optimizations and bug fixes
notes.notes:
The settings function has been integrated with the workshop interface, the old settings interface is no longer available.

The settings of the built-in model and the settings of the custom model are merged, and are no longer handled separately.

Optimized the multi-monitor switching function.

Fixed some bugs and optimized performance.

notes.title: Bug fixes and optimizations
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an issue that caused items not to be displayed when opening the workshop interface.
2. Fixed the issue that the model position display is not normal when switching between multiple monitors.
3. Some minor optimizations have been made.

notes.title: Bug fixes and optimizations
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an issue where the Workshop interface is not fully displayed on some different resolution monitors.
2. The display of setting options is optimized.

notes.title: Bug fixes and optimizations
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the problem of memory skyrocketing when loading models frequently.
2. Some performance optimizations have been made.

notes.title: Bug fixes and optimizations
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an issue that caused some users to be unable to open the workshop interface.
2. Optimized the UI display of some functions.

notes.title: Game update and repair
notes.notes:
April 26, 2020 game updates are as follows 

1. Fix the situation of black screen when some players start the game

2. Repair the white frame on some players' screens

3. Add the current location of the saved model when the game exits

4.Add model locking function, and the locking function is at the tray

PS: please understand that the above update may fail to repair due to force majeure.
